faq: The language pair, volume, subject, format and deadline. Compare offers for the same scope.
Does an enquiry place an order?
No. Work requires prior agreement on the scope and acceptance of the offer.
Do I need a certified translation?
Check the requirements of the institution receiving your document and include them in your enquiry.

services.title: Documents and certified translations
services.description: Documents for employment, education and formal procedures.
paragraphs: Send legible scans of all pages, including stamps and annotations. State the country and institution that will receive the document.
Check the required translation format. Provide name spellings and the submission deadline; originals and delivery are agreed separately.

services.title: Business translations
paragraphs: Identify the audience and purpose of your business materials. Specify the tone and whether the original layout should be retained.
Include a glossary, product names and approved examples. For multiple files, identify priorities and deadlines.

services.title: Specialist content
services.description: Context and consistent terminology for industry-specific texts.
paragraphs: Explain the industry and intended audience. Include drawings, terminology lists or earlier versions that clarify the material.
Identify codes and names that must remain unchanged. A sample helps establish the scope of work and final file format.

services.title: Websites and localisation
services.description: Content suited to your new market.
paragraphs: Gather page text, product descriptions, labels and messages. Include page titles and search result descriptions.
For short texts, add screen context and character limits. Specify the market and export format; technical work is agreed separately.
